text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr! I got my butt kicked again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can look an
Umamusume in the
face in this
condition...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even though I—more than anyone
else—am here
trying to pay respect to
them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I was all talk.
I couldn't do it at all... I
don't even
deserve to call myself a simp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I was all talk.
I couldn't do it at all... I
don't even
deserve to call myself a simp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Really? You think I can try my best for
my oshis?
choice_data_list: I know just how serious you are.
I know very well how serious you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gyuh... Th-thank you! I guess I lost
myself there
for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever doubt the love I feel?!
I'm going
to run for them! I'm going to
get stronger... for
them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because that is how I simp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! You've helped me remember

something very important!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital renews her will to fight
and looks
firmly to the future.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to cause any trouble...
I just want to
watch them from a distance
closer than anyone
else can get!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: Then let's give it our best.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fiery... passion...
That's right! If nothing else, I
have absolute confidence in this
fire burning in
my heart!
choice_data_list: As long as you have that burning p...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm gonna run until I burn out
in a
blaze of glory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But even then, my ashes will take to the
wind so I
can chase my oshis to the ends
of the Earth!
